title: Ike's Morning Digest
data_note: Built from publisher RSS metadata (titles + teaser text). `coverage_window_hours` is the default (40h); several feeds use a longer `rollingHours` (see `scripts/build-digest.mjs`) so rows align with what is still on each publisher’s listing pages. section_overviews.commercial_observer:
Women’s Clothing Store Esti’s Takes 8K SF at 2263 Nostrand Avenue in Midwood: High-end women’s clothing store Esti’s is relocating to a new mixed-use development in Midwood, Brooklyn, Commercial Observer has learned. The longtime retailer’s 7,800-square-foot lease at 2263 Nostrand Avenue was signed on Tuesday.

Fashion Boutique Atelier Secures Retail Space at 181 MacDougal Street: Fashion boutique Atelier New York is upgrading its retail footprint in Manhattan’s Greenwich Village. The multi-brand luxury boutique will be the inaugural tenant in the commercial component of the Straus Group ’s newly constructed 181 MacDougal Street luxury condominium building, Commercial Observer has learned.

Friedman’s Restaurant Ownership Buys Upper West Side Retail Space to Open New Spot: The ownership group behind famed New York City restaurants Friedman’s Restaurant and Pastrami Queen has acquired a retail co-op on Manhattan’s Upper West Side to open a new eatery, Commercial Observer has learned.

Hibachi Eatery Bijin Omakase Signs 5K-SF Lease in Long Island City: A hibachi restaurant is igniting the burner in Long Island City, Queens. Bijin Omakase signed a 15-year, 5,077-square-foot lease at the base of Trio , a nine-story, 34-unit residential development owned by ZD Jasper Realty at 27-19 Thomson Avenue near where the thoroughfare meets popular Jackson Avenue, according to.
section_overviews.cre_daily:
San Francisco Centre Returns to Market at Deep Discount: San Francisco Centre is back for sale after closing earlier this year and losing a proposed redevelopment buyer in July. Brokers expect bids of no more than $130M, far below the mall’s $1.2B valuation from a decade ago.

Florida Retail Leaders Put AI and Data at Center: AI and real-time data are becoming everyday tools for site selection, leasing, marketing, research, and operations. High construction costs and tight vacancy are increasing the focus on adaptive reuse, second-generation space, and flexible activation strategies.

Lululemon Slows US Store Growth as New CEO Takes Helm: Lululemon plans to open a net 35 new stores in 2026, down from its previous target of 40, while cutting 25 planned pop-ups. North American sales fell 12%, and global profit declined 1% to $1.5B, including roughly $135M in tariff refunds.

Spirit Halloween Turns Retail Vacancies into Seasonal Wins: Spirit Halloween opens roughly 1,500 temporary stores annually through a specialized leasing operation targeting vacant retail space. Flexible termination clauses let landlords collect temporary rent while preserving opportunities to sign permanent tenants.
section_overviews.new_york_post:
San Francisco’s deserted shopping palace heads for sale with staggering fall in value: New proposals for the space include a mixed-use project or massive sports complex.

Steph Curry offloads massive SF property as speculation swirls over future with Warriors: Curry appears to have scored millions after offloading a massive property in the Bay Area.

NYC penthouse forged from a famed copper roof finds its first-ever owner for a fraction of its $40M ask: A raw triplex beneath an iconic copper roof overlooking Central Park, once asking $40M, is now pending sale for $6.765M after auction.

25 years after 9/11, the World Trade Center’s last tower finally rises: “After 9/11, I made a promise to New Yorkers that we would rebuild the World Trade Center, commemorate those we lost [and] restore commerce to Lower Manhattan," developer Larry Silverstein told The Post.

items.headline: Women’s Clothing Store Esti’s Takes 8K SF at 2263 Nostrand Avenue in Midwood
items.summary: High-end women’s clothing store Esti’s is relocating to a new mixed-use development in Midwood, Brooklyn, Commercial Observer has learned. The longtime retailer’s 7,800-square-foot lease at 2263 Nostrand Avenue was signed on Tuesday. Asking rent for the 10-year deal was $65 per square foot. The retail space at the corner of Nostrand Avenue and Avenue I occupies a large slice of the newly constructed property’s retail component, leaving just 2,700 square feet available.…

items.headline: San Francisco Centre Returns to Market at Deep Discount
items.summary: San Francisco Centre is back for sale after closing earlier this year and losing a proposed redevelopment buyer in July. Brokers expect bids of no more than $130M, far below the mall’s $1.2B valuation from a decade ago. The WSJ reported the property is 93% vacant, with an ownership and ground-lease structure that has already derailed one deal. Key Takeaways The Wall Street Journal reports that San Francisco Centre is back on the market after closing earlier this year. A proposed buyer walked away in July.…

items.headline: Fashion Boutique Atelier Secures Retail Space at 181 MacDougal Street
items.summary: Fashion boutique Atelier New York is upgrading its retail footprint in Manhattan’s Greenwich Village. The multi-brand luxury boutique will be the inaugural tenant in the commercial component of the Straus Group ’s newly constructed 181 MacDougal Street luxury condominium building, Commercial Observer has learned. Asking rent for the 2,130-square-foot retail space was $250 per square foot, according to landlord broker Newmark .…

items.headline: Friedman’s Restaurant Ownership Buys Upper West Side Retail Space to Open New Spot
items.summary: The ownership group behind famed New York City restaurants Friedman’s Restaurant and Pastrami Queen has acquired a retail co-op on Manhattan’s Upper West Side to open a new eatery, Commercial Observer has learned. The restaurant group, using the LLC Mountain View Acquisition , bought the 5,000-square-foot retail unit at 541-555 Amsterdam Avenue for $4.1 million, according to buyer representative Lee & Associates NYC .…

items.headline: Hibachi Eatery Bijin Omakase Signs 5K-SF Lease in Long Island City
items.summary: A hibachi restaurant is igniting the burner in Long Island City, Queens. Bijin Omakase signed a 15-year, 5,077-square-foot lease at the base of Trio , a nine-story, 34-unit residential development owned by ZD Jasper Realty at 27-19 Thomson Avenue near where the thoroughfare meets popular Jackson Avenue, according to landlord and tenant broker RTL . Asking rent for the space was $130 per square foot.…

items.headline: Dermatology Chain LaserAway Adds 15th NYC Location on the Upper East Side
items.summary: Skin care, hair removal and body wellness services provider LaserAway is getting ready to open its 15th New York City location on Manhattan’s Upper East Side, Commercial Observer has learned. LaserAway signed a 10-year lease for 1,800 square feet on the ground floor of a mixed-use property at 242 East 86th Street , according to a source close to the deal. Asking rent was $165 per square foot.…

items.headline: Florida Retail Leaders Put AI and Data at Center
items.summary: AI and real-time data are becoming everyday tools for site selection, leasing, marketing, research, and operations. High construction costs and tight vacancy are increasing the focus on adaptive reuse, second-generation space, and flexible activation strategies. Well-located Florida retail continues to attract capital, especially grocery-anchored, necessity-based, and service-oriented properties. Key Takeaways Florida retail real estate is leaning harder on data, AI, and physical experience.…

items.headline: Dongbei Chinese Restaurant & Bar Inks Deal at 63 Cooper Square
items.summary: Dongbei Chinese Restaurant & Bar is opening its fourth location in New York City and its fifth overall, Commercial Observer has learned. The growing Northern Chinese dining concept signed a 2,000-square-foot lease at 63 Cooper Square , an East Village property owned by Matthew Rettner , according to landlord broker Meridian Capital Group . Asking rent for the space was $21,600 per month, and the tenant signed a 15-year lease.…

items.headline: Seafood Restaurant Crab House Takes 7K SF at 11 East 13th Street
items.summary: It’s the catch of the day! All-you-can-eat seafood chain Crab House has secured its fourth New York City location at 11 East 13th Street in Manhattan’s Greenwich Village neighborhood, Commercial Observer has learned. The 6,500-square-foot space between Fifth Avenue and University Place went fishing for a new proprietor in early August, following the departure of Mediterranean tapas restaurant Reyna New York.…

items.headline: Pilates Studio Sancta Selects Tribeca’s 124 Hudson Street for First Location
items.summary: A high-end Pilates studio has found its center in Manhattan’s Tribeca neighborhood. Sancta , a studio specializing in reformer Pilates, has inked a 2,350-square-foot lease for its debut location at 124 Hudson Street , Commercial Observer has learned. The studio agreed to a seven-year term with landlord Marx Realty for the ground-floor lease, with an asking rent of $150 per square foot.…

items.headline: Lululemon Slows US Store Growth as New CEO Takes Helm
items.summary: Lululemon plans to open a net 35 new stores in 2026, down from its previous target of 40, while cutting 25 planned pop-ups. North American sales fell 12%, and global profit declined 1% to $1.5B, including roughly $135M in tariff refunds. The pullback signals a more cautious retail leasing environment as consumers reduce spending and brands reassess expansion commitments. Key Takeaways Bisnow reports that Lululemon is scaling back its US store expansion plans as weaker sales pressure the athleisure retailer.…

items.headline: Spirit Halloween Turns Retail Vacancies into Seasonal Wins
items.summary: Spirit Halloween opens roughly 1,500 temporary stores annually through a specialized leasing operation targeting vacant retail space. Flexible termination clauses let landlords collect temporary rent while preserving opportunities to sign permanent tenants. The strategy shows how pop-up retail can monetize downtime, especially when bankrupt chains leave usable big-box locations behind.…

items.headline: Retail Location Intelligence Sharpens Site Selection
items.summary: Retail location intelligence platforms can model revenue, cash-on-cash returns, and store cannibalization down to specific streets and sites. Bain’s Vantage combines global data sets and machine learning with demographic, competitive, and retailer-specific information. Industry executives say technology improves site selection, but local sales knowledge and street-level context remain essential.…

items.headline: Westfield Topanga Tests Pop-Ups to Revive Food Hall
items.summary: URW is bringing Chain to Topanga Social for a six-month residency beginning September 2, 2026. The food hall has lost most of its original 25-plus vendors since opening at Westfield Topanga in 2023. The test reflects a broader push to use rotating dining and entertainment concepts to generate repeat mall visits. Key Takeaways CoStar reports that Westfield Topanga is trying a new food hall strategy after Topanga Social lost most of its original vendors.…

items.headline: Coney Island Prep Inks 45K-SF Deal to Relocate to 773 Neptune Avenue
items.summary: Coney Island Preparatory Public Charter School is moving from its Gravesend, Brooklyn, location to none other than Coney Island. The school signed a 39-year condominium leasehold agreement to build a 45,190-square-foot high school at Elie Fouerti ’s 773 Neptune Avenue , where it will grow to accommodate 500 students when it opens for enrollment in summer 2027, according to tenant broker Open Impact Real Estate . The new school is being developed by Rybak Development .…

items.headline: Law Firm Thompson Relocates to 4K SF at Cohen Brothers’ 622 Third Avenue
items.summary: This law firm finds its new office very appealing. Thompson , a law firm that specializes in mergers and acquisitions, tax transactions, and intellectual property issues, is relocating its New York City offices to the Cohen Brothers ’ 622 Third Avenue , Commercial Observer has learned. The boutique firm signed a five-year, 4,000-square-foot lease on the 16th floor of the 40-story Midtown East office tower, also known as Grand Central Plaza .…

items.headline: RFR Buys Prada-Anchored Retail Condo at 841 Madison Avenue for $57M
items.summary: An Upper East Side retail condominium at 841 Madison Avenue has traded hands for $57 million, Commercial Observer has learned. JSRE Acquisitions , which is associated with the Safra family and Status Capital , sold the East 70th Street unit occupied by luxury fashion house Prada to Aby Rosen and Michael Fuchs ‘s RFR Holding , according to the brokers. Global Advisory founder Ross Mezzo and Ezra Saffati from Majestic Acquisitions represented the buyer and the seller.…

items.headline: Apparel Manufacturer Bagatelle International Takes 24K SF at 463 Seventh Avenue
items.summary: Canadian fashion brand and apparel manufacturer Bagatelle International is relocating to a full-floor lease at 463 Seventh Avenue . The 23,785-square-foot deal is the largest of two new office leases at the Arsenal Company ’s Garment District tower between West 35th and West 36th streets. The transactions span a collective 33,083 square feet and bring the 22-story building to full occupancy, according to landlord brokers Adams & Company . Asking rent for both deals was $59 per square foot.…

items.headline: Law Firm O’Melveny Renews 100K SF at 1625 Eye Street in D.C.
items.summary: O’Melveny & Myers has signed a 15-year renewal for roughly 100,000 square feet at 1625 Eye Street NW in Washington, D.C., as the building’s new ownership group sets up a substantial renovation. The global law firm has been at the 405,000-square-foot building since 2003 and occupies the top three floors as its largest tenant. GreenBarn Investment Group , FarmView Ventures and capital partner Farallon Capital acquired the property in 2025 .…

items.headline: Two Supermarkets Ink Deals Along Brooklyn’s Atlantic Avenue
items.summary: Two new supermarkets are coming to Atlantic Avenue in Prospect Heights, Brooklyn. The grocers will arrive at two of EMP Capital Group ’s newly developed residential projects two blocks apart at 880 Atlantic Avenue and 1042 Atlantic Avenue , Commercial Observer has learned. In the largest deal, CTown Supermarkets signed a 20-year lease for 8,400 square feet at the base of the 19-story, 237-unit 1042 Atlantic Avenue, also known as Prosper Brooklyn , which was completed this year.…

items.headline: Reforming Pilates to Open New Studio at 233 East 34th Street in Murray Hill
items.summary: Almost started this story with a workout pun, but that would have been too much of a stretch. Fitness brand Reforming Pilates , which offers reformer equipment classes and heated mat workouts, has signed a 10-year, 2,500-square-foot lease to open a new location at 233 East 34th Street , according to landlord broker Meridian Capital Group . “Murray Hill is the heartbeat of Manhattan,” Genevieve Ross , founder of Reforming Pilates, said in a statement.…

items.headline: Cricket Training Facility Takes 14K SF Near Bryant Park for First U.S. Location
items.summary: Anyone fancy a game of cricket? Century Cricket Centre , an Australia-based indoor cricket and sports-tech concept, will open its first U.S. location in New York City, having inked a 14,000-square-foot lease at Thor Equities ’ 25 West 39th Street a block south of Bryant Park , tenant broker Lee & Associates NYC announced Tuesday.…

items.headline: Retail Location Intelligence Grows in Sophistication and Usage
items.summary: In the late 1960s, science fiction writer Arthur C. Clarke posited a now-famous law of the universe: “Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic.” As the rapid advancement of technology, especially given the ongoing progress of artificial intelligence, often makes this seem truer by the day, its implications in commercial real estate are often of a type that would have seemed like pure voodoo to CRE professionals when Clarke put forth this statement.…
